headline: Modernization options should connect to business outcomes and measurable signals.
intro: Select outcomes that fit the operating context, then establish a baseline before setting targets.
direction_1_detail: Assess support for new products, channels, markets, and partner integrations.
direction_2_detail: Measure manual effort, process errors, handoff delays, and cycle time.
direction_3_detail: Review journey continuity, self-service access, and decision latency.
direction_4_detail: Assess support lifecycle, recovery capability, security controls, and service fragility.
direction_5_detail: Evaluate integration, data access, and architecture change options.
direction_6_detail: Compare licenses, infrastructure, operations, and legacy support using validated baselines.
closing: Choose relevant outcomes and link each one to a measure, owner, and specific capability.
